system.description:
Requirements: Borrow the Stone, and you must be utilizing Mountain King Style

Cost: 1-3 Focus

Your martial practice and arcane knowledge of the earth have come to harmonize with each other, and you know how to flow from one to the other.

When you make a casting check for a spell with the Earth trait, you may spend up to 3 Focus, before or after rolling: you gain +1 bonus Expertise on that check per Focus spent.

Additionally, ending your turn after casting a spell with the Earth trait activates Channel the Stone from Mountain King Style, granting you an additional +1 Focus.
